title: Clique existence is monotone under edge addition
statement: For any natural numbers $v$ and $k$, if a graph on $v$ vertices contains a clique of size $k$, then every graph on the same vertices whose edge set contains the first graph's edge set also contains a clique of size $k$.
hypotheses_covered: the first graph's edges are all present in the second graph
